summary: ZeroStack Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on August 21, 2026, supplementing prior disclosure about its August 19, 2026 completion of the acquisition of 925,925,926 MemeCore (M) tokens via a private placement under a Securities Purchase Agreement with certain investors. The filing restates disclosure from a Form S-3 shelf registration statement and includes routine forward-looking statement language. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or closing condition is stated. This is a supplementary current report tied to an earlier token purchase and shelf registration, not a standalone special situation, so no deal terms are extractable.
